paper: Attention-guided quantum-inspired extreme learning machine with grey wolf optimization for rare-attack detection in IIoT networks
venue: Discover Artificial Intelligence (Springer Nature), 2026, article in press
dataset: Edge-IIoTset (processed by the paper's authors: 1,909,671 rows, 15 classes, 48 features)
statement: Every value below is transcribed from the published article and is labelled paper-reported. None of these values was computed, reproduced or verified by this repository. Demo metrics produced by this repository live in examples/output/metrics.json and are labelled demo.

binary_table6.source_locator: Table 6 (binary task: Normal vs attack), Section 5

settings_from_paper.encoder: 48 -> 128 -> 64 -> 8 tokens x 32, 8 heads d_k 32, FFN x4 GELU, dropout 0.1, learned feature-index embedding

gwo.fitness: 5-fold CV macro-F1 on the training partition

training.loss: focal gamma 2 alpha 0.25 with inverse-frequency class weights

notes.friedman_inconsistency: The article reports the Friedman statistic as chi-square 50.00 (df 10, p 2.67e-7) in the abstract and Section 5.7, and as chi-square 54.98 in the contributions list. The two figures cannot both be correct for the same test; this repository records the inconsistency and does not choose between them.
notes.not_reproduced: No real-data run was performed here. Nothing in this repository is labelled reproduced.
notes.upstream_code: The article cites https://github.com/drmohammedadnan110-ai/Attention-QELM-GWO-IIoT-IDS as its code source. That repository was not audited, executed or reused for this implementation.
